spec: Test-side: each rule card's whole option registration — every key with its registered default and values — as the deployed core registered it, under the build it was read from (the core's own library_version), or 'not-captured'. Written by scripts/snapshot_core_registrations.py; the package carries only the keys (registration in atlas/data/core_audit.json), and tests/test_oddities.py holds this file against the deployed cores and its keys against the audit record's.
